description: New config('services.slack.ops_webhook') read, but config/services.php defines no slack key and .env.example is not updated.
notes: §17b is the mirror of §3g: not 'don't read env at runtime' but 'make sure the value exists to read'. config/services.php IS in the tree, so the reviewer can verify the key is genuinely absent. §3g must not fire (this is config(), not env()). §9 must not fire — ->timeout(10) is present. §10 must not fire — ->throw() handles the response. That ->throw() is load-bearing and was added in 1.66.0: without it the call is fire-and-forget with no ->successful() check and no try/catch, §10's first bullet fires, and the case fails for a reason that has nothing to do with config drift. Verified against the pre-1.66.0 lens that this was a latent fixture bug, not a rule regression. A fixture must be clean on every dimension except the one it is testing.
